page_title: 配置导出、恢复出厂和Gsensor校准值导出
page_content:
[TOC]

### 前提条件：

- MDVR主机、遥控器、显示屏、存储介质或U盘


###操作步骤
#####配置导出
1、通电开机遥控进入菜单>>工具>>配置管理>>配置管理界面
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=1759310e17fa7776a2603a75c6c3869a)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=15a8e61633718d087a328443a6886798)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f34405330c9b203335a05471d0c7045f)
2、移动到 导出配置文件项 再按ENTER确认键，弹出导出成功
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=abf936c7acf849f94523954e57f212f1)
#####恢复出厂设置
3、移动到 恢复出厂设置，按遥控器ENTER键，弹窗恢复出厂设置确认信息“确认要恢复出厂设置吗？”，选择是，进行恢复出厂设置操作，提示“恢复完毕，系统即将重启！”，设备重启（选择否取消恢复出厂操作）
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=7f18002a4a62918b9e88057869d87cdc)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=163afa95d9520d0183c8a179e275f11d)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a4d61fa682ab87efc99536b57f8534e2)
#####Gsensor校准值导出
4、移动到 导出Gsensor校准值，按遥控器ENTER键，返回导出成功
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=99721264dbf701d42d1103e46fc9a91e)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=653a959aa946b543b5b41297ce99e2a9)
ps:取出存储介质，把存储介质插入其他设备关锁通电开机，设备自动完成config.xml和gsensor文件导入并自动重启。可在存储介质插入设备前先在电脑查看复制多个config.xml和gsensor文件用于批量导入。
